message.content: The claim is confirmed with exhaustive evidence over the full legal domain. I'll record the verdict.

function.arguments: {"confidence": 0.97, "decisive_claims": ["c1"], "reason": "Probe t7 swept all 63488 finite FP16 values (the entire legal input domain per problem.txt) through the kernel and compared against the FP64 reference. 15728 values (24.8% of the domain) violate the contract tolerance abs(actual - rho(x)) <= 1e-8 + 1e-5*abs(rho(x)); max absolute error ~1.99e-4. The cause is the kernel's direct FP32 evaluation of sqrt(1+x*x)-1 (kernel.py lines 17-18), which catastrophically cancels for small-to-moderate x (violations begin around x~1.4e-4). The contract permits algebraic rewrites, and the stable form x*x/(sqrt(1+x*x)+1) — which the kernel's own reference() uses — would satisfy the tolerance, so this is a fixable defect, but as shipped the kernel violates the required tolerance on a large in-scope fraction of the domain.", "verdict": "reject"}
